situations.headline: Kropz halts Phosrock production, restructures Elandsfontein amid sustained losses

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Kropz halts Phosrock production, restructures Elandsfontein amid sustained losses (interest 4, risk 8)

thesis.text: Kropz is a distressed single-asset (Elandsfontein) phosphate producer forced to halt its core Phosrock production due to sustained unprofitability from adverse pricing and cost inflation, pivoting to an unproven, lower-volume Nanophos niche market; the situation is a turnaround/restructuring event with high downside risk pending evidence that Nanophos can restore sustainable cash flow, and future announcements (job cuts, MPRDA filings, funding needs, Nanophos traction) should be monitored closely.
